summary: Software engineer who builds LLM features and the data pipelines behind them. Ships Python services, React front ends, and evaluation harnesses that catch regressions before users do.

work_experience.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
work_experience.description: Larkspur runs freight brokerage software; the applied AI team automates document intake for 300+ carrier partners.
highlights: Built a FastAPI service that extracts fields from bills of lading with GPT-4o and validates them against carrier records, cutting manual data entry by 62%.
Designed a retrieval pipeline over 1.4M shipment documents using pgvector and hybrid BM25 search, raising answer accuracy on an internal eval set from 71% to 88%.
Wrote an evaluation harness with 420 labeled cases that runs in GitHub Actions on every prompt change and blocks merges that drop accuracy.
Moved three batch jobs from cron on EC2 to ECS scheduled tasks with Terraform, removing 9 hours of monthly on-call toil.

work_experience.title: Software Engineer
work_experience.description: Brightwater builds scheduling and intake software for outpatient clinics.
highlights: Rebuilt the patient intake form in React and TypeScript with field-level validation, lowering incomplete submissions from 18% to 6%.
Built a Python ETL that loads 2.3M appointment records nightly into PostgreSQL for the analytics team, with row-count and schema checks.
Trained a scikit-learn no-show model on 3 years of appointment history that clinics use to schedule reminder calls.

projects.name: Quillmark: Lecture Notes Search
projects.description: A search app over recorded lecture transcripts that answers questions with timestamps back to the video.
highlights: Chunked 600+ hours of transcripts by speaker turn and embedded them into a local vector index.
Added reranking with a cross-encoder, which improved top-3 hit rate from 64% to 81% on 150 hand-written questions.

projects.name: Tidepool Budget Bot
projects.description: A Telegram bot that categorizes bank CSV exports and sends a weekly spending summary.
highlights: Parses exports from 4 banks into one schema and categorizes transactions with rules plus an LLM fallback.
